index.description: An index expression that restricts which indices are considered. Defaults to `metrics-*`

start.description: The start of the range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp or Unix time in seconds

end.description: The end of the range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp or Unix time in seconds

step.description: The resolution between samples, as a number of seconds or a duration such as `30s`

limit.description: The maximum number of series to return. `0` means no limit from the request

timeout.description: The evaluation timeout, as a number of seconds or a duration such as `30s`. Capped by `xpack.prometheus.query.timeout`

body.description: For POST, the query parameters can be sent instead as a form-encoded body
